# delux v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

> Use LEDs for your user interface

## Pages

- [💡 delux 💡](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Delux](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/Delux.md): 
Use LEDs for your user interface
- [Delux.Effects](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/Delux.Effects.md): Functions for creating a variety of LED patterns

- [Delux.Morse](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/Delux.Morse.md): Functions for Morse code patterns

- [Delux.Pattern](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/Delux.Pattern.md): Utility functions for handling element sequences for one LED

- [Delux.Program](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/Delux.Program.md): Create LED patterns
- [Delux.RGB](https://delux.hexdocs.pm/Delux.RGB.md): Utilities for RGB tuples
